assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Acute triangle ABC with rays AX and AY outside it, each making the angle theta with AB and AC; B0 and C0 are the feet of the dashed perpendiculars from B and C to these rays; P, Q, M are the midpoints of AB, AC, BC, joined in green to B0, M and C0, and the red segments MB0 and MC0 are the two equal lengths.

difficulty_rationale: The proof needs the auxiliary midpoints of AB and AC, the median-to-hypotenuse fact and an angle chase that sets up an SAS congruence; spotting these together is a meaningful insight.
